entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane of perpetual renaissance with beautiful cities, ingenious inventors and dangerous politics.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The capital of Fiora, where murder and subterfuge are common and political factions vie for control; its laws mystically bind the populace.

entities.name: Drakestown
entities.description: A town far from the High City bordering the wilderness, where everyone was viciously murdered years ago.

entities.name: The massacre of Drakestown
entities.description: The vicious murder of everyone in Drakestown years ago, their lives lost to an unknown scheme.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: An explorer, one of the first to travel Fiora's frontier.

events.summary: Everyone in Drakestown was viciously murdered years ago to an unknown scheme.
events.quote: everyone was viciously murdered here years ago, their lives lost to an unknown scheme.

events.summary: The explorer Selvala was one of the first to travel the frontier, seeking the world beyond the nobles' debauchery.

relations.quote: In the capital of Fiora—Paliano, the High City—murder and subterfuge are common.
